rss_note: macOS ps RSS, sampled about every 0.1s. Not Linux PSS. cpu_seconds is ps cputime at the end of the crawl and includes process start. Same-process print-flag-values was not left on; a throwaway start of this binary printed max-semi-space-size=1 because optimize-for-size overrides the requested 4. rss_end_kb is the single ps sample after the crawl returned and before shutdown.
